title: Pre-cutover shadow parity report
description: data_collection/parity/{trading_day}.json (data-collector plan §6.2 step 4, alpha-engine-config-I10778). Written by `python -m shadow parity`, which diffs one standalone shadow run's output under staging/shadow/{trading_day}/ against the same trading day's v1 output, per key: row count, symbol set, schema, value tolerance. Read by nousergon-data/data_gate/evidence.py::read_parity as the `data.cutover_ready.parity` clause's evidence (alpha-engine-config-I10777). PRODUCER TEST: tests/test_shadow_parity.py. v1.

trading_day.description: The trading day BOTH sides were produced for. The whole point of the override is that this is the same day on both sides; the weaker fallback in plan §6.2 step 4 compares against the previous day.

generated_at.description: UTC timestamp the comparison ran. The gate clause's as_of, and what makes a stale report visibly stale rather than silently reused.

shadow_prefix.description: The output root the shadow run was confined to. shadow/root.py::ShadowRoot.prefix is the single source of this string.

code_sha.description: The commit the comparison ran from, or the literal "unknown" when the checkout is not a git working tree.

met.description: TRUE only when every row's verdict is `match`. An unmeasurable, missing or in-region-only row is not parity evidence (plan §4.1 rule 2: UNMEASURABLE is never met), so it makes this false.

summary.description: Counts by verdict, plus `total`. Every verdict in the row enum appears as a key.

excluded_units.description: Units deliberately not compared, each with its reason. Present so the report's denominator is auditable: a unit missing from `keys` is either here or a finding.

class.description: hand_excluded: EXCLUDED_UNITS (a declared, reviewable exception). lifecycle: no live v1 producer for this unit's declared lifecycle. out_of_run_scope: the unit produced no run manifest under this shadow run — it was not part of the workload the run executed (alpha-engine-config-I10890).

key.description: The LIVE key (or, for an unaddressable declaration, the descriptor's own text). The shadow side is this key under `shadow_prefix`, carried in `shadow_key`.

shadow_library.description: For an ArcticDB row: the shadow library the run wrote, which an in-region comparator diffs against the live library named in `key`.

unit_ids.description: Every unit declaring this write. Two units on one key (D17/D19 on staging/daily_closes) is one comparison attributed to both.

verdict.description: `in_region_only` is its own verdict rather than a flavour of `unmeasurable` because it names a DIFFERENT next action: run the comparator in-region, not fix a read. `live_superseded` (alpha-engine-config-I10892): v1's run manifest for this trading day records an ETag the live key no longer carries, and no retained VersionId to fetch the recorded object by — the live object belongs to a later run, so it is not evidence either way. Never met.

live_version.description: Which live object was graded, against v1's run manifest for the trading day (alpha-engine-config-I10892). `basis`: `current_matches_manifest` (the current object IS the recorded one), `manifest_version_id` (the recorded VersionId was fetched), `superseded_no_version_id`, `recorded_version_not_retained`, or `unrecorded` (no manifest record carrying an etag — graded against the current object, as before).

provenance_diffs.description: Differences confined to fields the resolved contract marks `x-provenance` (alpha-engine-config-I10894) — e.g. `revision`, `fetched_at`. Reported as information; NEVER counted in `values.breaches` and never met-breaking.
